name: PT Star Pacific Tbk
summary: PT Star Pacific Tbk engages in the real estate business in Indonesia. The company invests and leases real estate properties. It is also involved in management consultation; newspaper, journal, bulletin, and magazine publication; and provision of information technology and other computer services. The company was formerly known as PT Lippo E-Net Tbk and changed its name to PT Star Pacific Tbk in January 2009. PT Star Pacific Tbk was founded in 1983 and is based in Tangerang, Indonesia. PT Star Pacific Tbk operates as a subsidiary of PT Inti Anugrah Pratama.
